2026_02_NO_BAL.headline: New Orleans must survive Baltimore’s ground-game stress without conceding space to Lamar Jackson
2026_02_NO_BAL.paragraph1: Baltimore’s receiving and protection picture is unsettled, with Zay Flowers doubtful and multiple offensive linemen carrying injury concerns, making Lamar Jackson and Derrick Henry especially important to sustaining the Ravens’ offense. New Orleans must fit the run without committing so aggressively that Jackson finds escape lanes or favorable coverage. Chris Olave remains the Saints’ most dangerous receiving threat, so Baltimore also needs disciplined coverage behind its rush. Tackling in space and avoiding obvious passing downs are central for both offenses.
2026_02_NO_BAL.model_rationale: The Saints must balance run support with containment of Jackson, while Baltimore’s coverage and pressure need to prevent Shough and Olave from converting manageable situations into extended drives.
